Name: Retextured furniture- More Lovecraftian
Author: Catsine
Description:
Makes about 40 furniture items more intricate and darker.  Some small changes some complete changes. Floor tv is now a 20s radio for example. 

[b]Installation[/b]  

Extract and place the furniture xnb   ( your drive  )steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets   and overwrite when asked. 


Might add more in the future. Busy making a book for now though.

check out my other stardew mod here https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3297

Watch me do art live https://www.twitch.tv/Ernestventures
